# html

## Type Aliases

### HtmlWhistleBinding

```ts
type HtmlWhistleBinding = Readonly<{
  keymap: ReturnType<typeof createDefaultHtmlKeymap>;
  dispose: () => void;
}>;
```

Maintained document keymap plus disposable Whistle command projection.

## Functions

### bindHtmlKeymap()

```ts
function bindHtmlKeymap(root, whistle, origin): HtmlWhistleBinding;
```

Bind Whistle commands to the maintained OpenTUI HTML keymap. The root owns the
host's document lifetime; dispose removes the command projection only.
